nphi.title: Andean Health and Climate Change Plan 2026–2031
nphi.with: Health ministries of the six Andean countries; PAHO/WHO
nphi.summary: A subregional plan, approved in Lima in June 2026 and presented at the PAHO Directing Council, to help Andean health systems anticipate and respond to climate-related health risks through sector leadership, surveillance and evidence, and…

nphi.title: CDC South America Regional Office (SAMRO)
nphi.with: Brazil Ministry of Health – Secretariat of Health and Environmental Surveillance (General Coordination of Public Health Laboratories); Pará State Health Secretariat; Ecuador FETP
nphi.summary: Established in 2020 in Brasília, SAMRO supports surveillance modernisation, lab quality (SLIPTA/SLMTA with Brazil's lab network), FETP (Ecuador) and outbreak response (dengue, Oropouche, avian influenza) across South America.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: Saint Petersburg Pasteur Institute – INHRR joint diagnostic research
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Higiene Rafael Rangel (INHRR)
nphi.summary: Russian experts agreed a joint research plan with Venezuela's national hygiene institute in Caracas in June 2026, covering laboratory diagnosis of viral hepatitis, measles, rubella, parvovirus B19, diphtheria and pertussis with Russian…

nphi.title: CDC–PAHO regional course on influenza molecular diagnostics hosted by InDRE
nphi.actor: US CDC (WHO Collaborating Centre for Influenza)
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO; InDRE (host); National Influenza Centres of participating countries
nphi.summary: International training in August 2018 at Mexico's InDRE for National Influenza Centres and laboratories of 11 countries on PCR-based influenza detection, strengthening the regional GISRS network.
